THREE RACES. ONE WEEKEND.

01 / THE WEEKEND

ONE RACE
IS NEVER ENOUGH.

TRESOMNIUM is an imagined three-stage cycling weekend built for riders who can do more than one thing well. The time trial asks for precision. The road race tests endurance and nerve. The criterium rewards speed under pressure. Every finish matters: points accumulate across all three disciplines, and on Sunday afternoon, one rider stands above the rest.

THE WORK

Individual Time Trial

A short, demanding race against the clock. Technical streets, exposed farmland, and a final rise to the old observatory.
